blurb: Guests can experience glider flights including classic and acrobatic familiarization flights. The club offers training to become a licensed glider pilot starting from age 14. The club operates several gliders and tow planes at their aerodrome in St-Dominique, Quebec.
extraNote: Membership fees vary by age and date of joining, with discounts after August 1 · Tow plane fees and glider usage fees apply per hour or per 100 ft ASL · Operations depend on weather conditions · Aérodrome de St-Dominique, 1565 7e rang, St-Dominique, QC J0H 1L0 · Approximately early April to November
